'''Tebari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Tebari was present in the [[Underground]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] when collapses in the world's [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] resulted in the cantina's ceiling falling in, destroying the building. Tebari subsequently accompanied the [[Heroes of Cularin]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Ulucca]] and the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Nia Reston]], [[San Herrera]] and [[Philinda]] on an expedition into the crystal mines, to search for any people who had been trapped in the tunnels by the collapses.
